title: Australian Parrots And Their Adaptation To Habitat Change
description: Bài đọc về vẹt Úc và sự thích nghi với thay đổi môi trường sống

words.example: Nowhere do they display such a richness of diversity and form as in Australia.
words.collocation: biological diversity · cultural diversity · diversity of
words.note: Tính từ: diverse. Rất hay gặp trong IELTS khi nói về môi trường và xã hội.

words.example: Australia has long been renowned for the number and variety of its parrots.
words.collocation: renowned for · internationally renowned · renowned expert
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'famous'. Luôn đi với 'for'.

words.example: Parrots are descendants of an ancient line.
words.collocation: direct descendant · descendant of · living descendant
words.note: Trái nghĩa: ancestor (tổ tiên).

words.example: Since most species inhabit Africa, Australia and South America, it seems almost certain that parrots originated on the ancient continent of Gondwana.
words.collocation: inhabit a region · densely inhabited · inhabit the forest
words.note: Danh từ: inhabitant (cư dân).

words.example: Much of Gondwana comprised vast rainforests intersected by huge slow-flowing rivers and expansive lakes.
words.collocation: comprise of · mainly comprise · comprise a large proportion
words.note: Đồng nghĩa: consist of, be made up of.

words.example: Gondwana comprised vast rainforests intersected by huge slow-flowing rivers and expansive lakes.
words.collocation: expansive area · expansive view · expansive landscape

words.example: The rainforests that once covered it gradually contracted to the continental margins.
words.collocation: contract sharply · muscles contract · contract in size
words.note: Nhấn âm hai khi là động từ. Nhấn âm đầu /ˈkɒn.trækt/ khi là danh từ (hợp đồng).

words.example: The rainforests gradually contracted to the continental margins, where they still exist today.
words.collocation: profit margin · continental margin · by a narrow margin
words.note: Nhiều nghĩa: rìa (địa lý), lề (giấy), biên lợi nhuận (kinh tế).

words.example: The creatures that remained in those shrinking rainforests had to adapt to the drier conditions or face extinction.
words.collocation: face extinction · on the brink of extinction · mass extinction
words.note: Tính từ: extinct. Rất hay gặp trong IELTS chủ đề Environment.

words.vi: Thuộc tổ tiên, của tổ tiên
words.example: The parrots spread from ancestral forests through eucalypt woodlands to colonise the central deserts.
words.collocation: ancestral home · ancestral land · ancestral species
words.note: Danh từ: ancestor.

words.example: They diversified into a wide range of species with adaptations that reflect the many changes animals had to make.
words.collocation: diversify the economy · diversify into · diversify a portfolio
words.note: Danh từ: diversification.

words.vi: Sự thích nghi, sự thích ứng
words.example: They diversified into a wide range of species with adaptations that reflect the many changes animals had to make to survive.
words.collocation: adaptation to · evolutionary adaptation · climate adaptation
words.note: Động từ: adapt. Tính từ: adaptive.

words.example: These evolutionary pressures helped mould keratin into a range of tools capable of gathering the new food types.
words.collocation: evolutionary process · evolutionary theory · evolutionary pressure
words.note: Danh từ: evolution.

words.example: These evolutionary pressures helped mould keratin, the substance from which beaks are made, into a range of tools.
words.collocation: chemical substance · harmful substance · substance abuse

words.example: Some have comparatively long beaks that are perfect for extracting seeds from fruit.
words.collocation: extract information · extract oil · extract data
words.note: Danh từ: extraction. Nhấn âm hai khi là động từ, âm đầu khi là danh từ.

words.example: Flowers which depend on birds for pollination are more often red.
words.collocation: cross-pollination · insect pollination · pollination process
words.note: Động từ: pollinate.

words.example: The majority are nomadic to some degree, moving around to take advantage of feeding and breeding places.
words.collocation: nomadic lifestyle · nomadic people · nomadic tribe
words.note: Danh từ: nomad.

words.example: Forest clearing created grasslands where galahs and corellas thrive.
words.collocation: thrive in · thrive on · continue to thrive
words.note: Mạnh hơn 'survive': không chỉ sống sót mà còn phát triển tốt.

words.vi: Xoay sở, diễn ra (tốt hay xấu)
words.example: But other parrot species did not fare so well when their environments were altered.
words.collocation: fare well · fare badly · fare better
words.note: Nghĩa khác: giá vé (danh từ). Khi là động từ, thường đi với 'well/badly'.

words.vi: Môi trường sống, nơi cư trú
words.example: Numbers of ground parrots declined when a great part of their habitat was destroyed.
words.collocation: natural habitat · habitat loss · habitat destruction
words.note: Từ cốt lõi trong IELTS chủ đề Environment.

words.example: Even some parrot species that benefited from forest clearing at first are now confronted by a shortage of nesting sites.
words.collocation: confront a problem · be confronted with · confront challenges
words.note: Danh từ: confrontation.

words.example: After farmers cleared large areas of forest on Kangaroo Island, the island was colonised by galahs.
words.collocation: colonise an area · colonise new territory · colonise the land
words.note: Chính tả Mỹ: colonize. Danh từ: colonisation.

words.vi: Gây ra, thúc đẩy (thường là điều xấu)
words.example: Their success precipitated a partial collapse in the black cockatoo population.
words.collocation: precipitate a crisis · precipitate change · precipitate a decline
words.note: Mang sắc thái 'gây ra đột ngột'. Trang trọng hơn 'cause'.

words.example: The black cockatoo population collapsed when they lost the struggle for scarce nesting hollows.
words.collocation: scarce resources · increasingly scarce · scarce supply
words.note: Danh từ: scarcity.

words.example: There may be no final answer to ensuring an equitable balance between parrot species.
words.collocation: equitable distribution · equitable access · equitable solution
words.note: Khác 'equal' (bằng nhau). 'Equitable' nhấn mạnh sự công bằng, hợp lý.
